title: Rousing's Texture Pack
description: This is a texture pack made by RousingShip. It contains a style that you would not find anywhere else. With custom textures for blocks, mobs, and the hud. There is much to enjoy.
body: This is a texture pack made by RousingShip. It has custom textures for blocks, entities, armor, and the hud. With many things to explore and stylistic choices you may have never thought should exist, this texture pack changes the way you play Minecraft.
